subject: Gen6 Slice A revalidated against current main 7dd6821
body: Primary revalidated Slice A after the user root-import merge. Current GitHub main is 7dd6821cea09559e858cca61579da64a0f14ea71. The two production files patched by Slice A still exactly match the candidate baseline blobs: Fold7DeviceStateObserver.kt=760d075332740e5ee0d73766766175b17e6f9122 and FoldOverlayService.kt=cfc4706458e1da197e0e86ce74dc80c83489a2e6. Therefore the exact-baseline patch remains source-compatible despite the new root research/import files. Current TransitionLab.recordIngressStage still accepts serviceEpoch, presentationAttemptSequence and reason; Fold7ContinuityCoordinator still exposes generation. The Gen6 owner file is not present on main, confirming Slice A has not already been integrated. GitHub connector branch creation remains blocked by HTTP 403, so no production branch/commit was made. The new PUBLIC_GLASS/PRIVATE_FROST visual-security contract is downstream and does not expand/block Slice A. Please review the candidate against current main and issue READY_FOR_PRIMARY only with zero unresolved blockers.
